title: feat(record-page): the comment panel resolves, reopens and filters threads, counts the unresolved ones, and offers Edit and Delete on others' comments to a record editor (#36075)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuKfHUa83V2ZjrX6UrED642U)_

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgT8AtWDue4oTFNAE6H

Fixes #36075

Clause-②: yes (widening): `@object-ui/react`'s `DiscussionContextValue` adds three optional members, `onResolveComment(itemId, resolved)`, `moderatesComments` and `updatesOthersComments`. `@object-ui/types`' `FeedItem` adds five optional members: `resolved`, `resolvedById`, `resolvedByName`, `resolvedAt`, `mentionsViewer`. `@object-ui/plugin-detail` adds exports `useRecordVerdict` (three-state; a definite allow is `allowed` with `record.visible`; `useRecordEditable` reads as before except that `allowed: false` beside a visible record now reads not editable), `threadResolvable`, `threadResolved`, `threadInvolvesViewer`, `filterCommentThreads`, `unresolvedThreadCount`, `DEFAULT_COMMENT_THREAD_FILTER` and the type `CommentThreadFilter`; `RecordCommentsData` adds `resolvable`, `onResolveComment`, `moderates` and `updatesOthers`, and its `count` is now the unresolved threads; `CommentItemActions` adds `onResolve` and `resolved`; `CommentHoverActionsProps` adds `resolved`; `RecordCommentThreadProps['comments']` may carry `onResolveComment`, `moderates` and `updatesOthers`. `@object-ui/i18n` adds ten `detail.*` keys to every pack. Nothing existing is removed or re-typed.
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 评论栏里，每串评论的第一条在鼠标移上去时多了一个对勾。点一下这一串就标成「已解决」，从列表里消失，头部评论图标上的数字减一。再点一次可以恢复成未解决。
- 谁能点对勾：自己发起的串，谁都能点。别人发起的串，只在服务器会接受时才显示对勾。现在只有管理员能点别人发起的串。原因是平台有一条底线规则：普通成员只能改自己创建的行，评论也算，而且这条规则在评论自己的规则之前执行。实测在开发环境里，普通成员标别人的串返回 403，标自己的返回 200。你 13:25Z 的裁定 A（能看记录的人都能标）要等后端单独一个 PR 才能真正生效，这个 PR 不改服务端。
- 评论栏右上角多了一个筛选按钮，里面两个勾选：「显示已解决」打开后，已解决的串也显示出来，上面一行灰字「已由 某某 解决」，再点它的对勾就恢复。「只看我参与的」只留我发起的、我回复过的、提到我的串。筛选不记在浏览器里。全部都已解决时，评论栏说「没有未解决的评论」，并给一个「显示全部评论」的按钮。
- 往已解决的串里再回复，这一串自动变回未解决。图标上的数字现在是未解决的串数。
- 「更多」里的编辑和删除：
  - 自己的评论照旧（普通成员默认只有编辑：平台默认不给成员删评论的权限，这是另一张决定卡）。
  - 别人的评论：删除给能编辑这条记录、并且有评论删除权限的人。编辑还要服务器同意改别人写的行，现在也只有管理员。
  - 判断都问服务器，只有明确说「可以」才显示，没回来或出错就不显示。所以普通成员不会看到点了会被拒的按钮。
- 服务端权限一行没改。老部署（评论表里没有「已解决」这一列）不显示对勾和筛选，数字数全部串，和以前一样。手写的记录页和手机端不变。

## What changes

**Resolved threads** (`@object-ui/plugin-detail` `src/comments/`, the backend is #36071 / #36104)

- `commentThreads.ts`: `threadResolvable` (a real top-level comment, and the host set `resolved`: a reply whose parent is gone cannot be resolved, the server refuses it), `threadResolved`, `threadInvolvesViewer` (the viewer started the thread, replied in it, or is mentioned in it: #36071's `threadsInvolvingUser` rule, read off the host's viewer-relative marks), `filterCommentThreads` with `DEFAULT_COMMENT_THREAD_FILTER` (`showResolved: false`, `onlyMine: false`), `unresolvedThreadCount`.
- `useRecordComments`: `count` is the unresolved threads; `resolvable` says some thread here can be resolved; hands `onResolveComment` and `moderates` on from the context.
- `CommentThread`: ✓ on the thread's first comment only (`onResolve`, reading 「恢复」 and pressed when resolved), on a thread the viewer started, and on anyone's only with `updatesOthers` (see the row floor below). A resolved thread carries `data-comment-thread-resolved` and a 「已由 X 解决」 line (`data-comment-resolved-mark`) above its first comment, the comment muted while collapsed. The resolver's name is the host's (`resolvedByName`), else the entry in a mention list the composer already loaded (never read for this), else plain 「已解决」. A refused resolve is swallowed here (the host has said so).
- `CommentsPanel`: the filter menu (`ListFilter`, left of ✕) with two checkbox items, offered only while `resolvable`; held in state while the panel is open, never stored. With every thread filtered out it says 「没有未解决的评论」 (or 「没有你参与的评论」) and offers 「显示全部评论」.
- `CommentHoverActions`: `resolved` turns the ✓ into the reopen control (`aria-pressed`). Its test hook changes value with it: `data-comment-action="resolve"` on an open thread, `"reopen"` on a resolved one. The panel's other new hooks are `data-comments-filter`, `data-comments-filter-option="show-resolved" | "only-mine"`, `data-comments-empty="filtered"` and `data-comment-thread-resolved`; they are test hooks and carry no contract.

**Edit and Delete on other people's comments** (card item 6)

- The comment hook (`plugin-audit` `comment-access-hooks.ts`, "Parent EDIT") lets a comment's author, or a caller whose by-id update of the parent record the explain engine admits, edit or delete a comment. The page asks the same question: `useRecordVerdict(object, id, 'update')`, a three-state reading of the verdict `useRecordEditable` fails open on (same cache, same in-flight sharing, same staling; `useRecordEditable` is now `useRecordVerdict(...) ?? true`). A definite allow is `allowed === true` together with `record.visible === true`, as the server admits a by-id write (L2 S3); an answer with `allowed: false` beside a visible record (an on-behalf-of session whose delegator is gone) now reads not editable for `useRecordEditable` too, which is the server's answer. `moderatesComments` is `true` only on a definite allow, and is asked once the panel is open, so a record whose object sets `userActions.edit: false` still sends no explain on open (#13045). The page's own edit gates (approval lock, `userActions.edit`, predicates) are not the server's comment rule and do not join.
- `CommentThread` offers Delete on a comment that is the viewer's own or, with `moderates`, anyone's; Edit on the viewer's own or, with `moderates` AND `updatesOthers`, anyone's; still only where the host hands `onEditComment` / `onDeleteComment` (the `sys_comment` grants).

**The row floor (measured; the interim this PR ships)**

- The platform's wildcard floor `owner_only_writes` (`default-permission-sets.ts`, `update`, `positions: ['org_member']`, `created_by == current_user.id`) runs before the comment hook. `sys_comment` widens it for `delete` only (`sys_comment_moderation`); `update` is left under the floor on purpose. So the hook's resolve rule (#36104, ruling 7063285032) and its parent-editor rule are never reached for a rank-and-file member on someone else's row.
- Readings on the CRM example with the security service on (one org, two `org_member` members; scripts and JSON in the evidence folder `floor/`):
  - a member who reads the record PATCHes `{ is_resolved: true }` on the admin's thread: **403** `PERMISSION_DENIED`; on another member's thread: **403**; on their own: **200**;
  - a member who may edit the record PATCHes `{ body }` on another member's comment: **403**;
  - explain `sys_comment` `update` by id answers `record.visible: false` for a member on another person's comment, `true` on their own and for the admin.
- The interim: `RecordDetailView` asks ONE explain, `update` of the first top-level comment the viewer did not write (`updatesOthersComments`), when the reader first reaches into the open panel (pointer or focus), so opening the record and opening the panel still read nothing more (#28470). The floor answers the same for every such row. ✓ and Edit on others' rows need its definite allow; pending, a refusal, an error, no explain service and a stale answer offer them on the viewer's own rows alone. Delete keeps its own gates (`feedCommentDelete` and `moderatesComments`), which the floor's delete widening already matches.
- Not here: making ruling 7063285032 true for members is a server change (a resolve-only path past the floor), a separate backend PR after Sales answers the decision on editing others' comments. Delete was verified with a principal holding the `sys_comment` delete bit (the admin); `member_default` grants members none, so a member's More holds Edit only (a second decision card).

**The record page** (`@object-ui/app-shell` `RecordDetailView`)

- The comment read already returns every column (no select, on both the record-page payload and the fallback `find`), so the rows' `is_resolved`, `resolved_by`, `resolved_at` map onto the feed item (`commentResolutionOf`), only where the row carries `is_resolved`. The resolver is named from the viewer or an author of the same discussion; any other resolver is named by ONE `sys_user` read of exactly those ids (`$filter: { id: { $in } }`, `$select: ['id', 'name']`), sent after the discussion is drawn and never twice for an id (L2 S2: the record-page payload has no expand for it, and the 50-user mention roster missed resolvers past it). A refused read leaves 「已解决」. `mentionsViewer` comes from the row's stored `mentions` (`rowMentionsUser`: a JSON id list, ids or `{ id }` objects).
- `handleResolveComment`: `dataSource.update('sys_comment', id, { is_resolved })` and nothing else (the one update ruling 7063285032 admits for any reader), offered under the `sys_comment` update grant; the row changes from the stored record the server answers with, a refusal toasts `detail.commentResolveFailed` and changes nothing.
- A reply into a resolved thread shows its first comment reopened (`threadRootIdOf`), as the platform stores it; a new comment is unresolved where the deployment stores resolution.
- The icon's count is `unresolvedThreadCount` over the rows the page already holds from its one open request (#28470), not #36104's `COUNT` read: that would be a second request for an answer already on the page.

**Strings**: `detail.reopenThread`, `threadResolved`, `threadResolvedBy`, `filterComments`, `showResolvedComments`, `commentsInvolvingMe`, `noUnresolvedComments`, `noCommentsInvolvingMe`, `showAllComments`, `commentResolveFailed` in all eleven packs (zh-Hant regenerated) and the provider-less defaults.

**Docs**: the plugin-detail README and `content/docs/frontend/plugins/plugin-detail.mdx` describe resolved threads, the filter, the count, and Edit / Delete for record editors.

## Why

Card #36075 items 3, 6, 7 and 8, owed by this second PR after #36114 (the panel, `Part of #36075`) and #36104 (the resolved backend, #36071) merged: resolve and reopen a thread, the 「显示已解决」 / 「只看我参与的」 filter, the icon counting unresolved threads, and Edit / Delete 「只对自己的评论，或有权限的人」.

## Side effects reviewers should know

- No server change and no permission change. Resolving rides the backend #36104 shipped, and moderating uses the server's existing parent-editor rule, each offered only where the server's row floor admits it today (above).
- A deployment without the explain service shows ✓ and Edit on the viewer's own rows only, administrators included.
- The moderation verdict fails CLOSED where `useRecordEditable` fails open: a deployment whose explain engine does not answer (501, network) shows Edit / Delete on the viewer's own comments only, though its degraded server mode might admit more. A permitted moderator there loses an affordance, never sees a refused one.
- The old `RecordActivityTimeline` (hand-written pages, the phone) is unchanged: own Edit / Delete only, no resolve.
- Overlap: `overlap-check.mjs` against main and 5 open PRs that share a file: clean, except #36136, which already conflicts with main on `RecordDetailView.tsx`'s `@object-ui/plugin-detail` import line; this PR adds its two names on a separate import so it adds nothing to that conflict.
- Not in this PR: 「复制链接」 in the More menu (in the mock, not in the card's items), and reactor names on hover.

## Verification

**New tests (all pass)**

- `plugin-detail/src/comments/CommentsPanel.resolved-36075.test.tsx` (16): resolved threads hidden by default; ✓ on a top-level comment only; 「显示已解决」 with 「Resolved by Ada」 and the reopen control; 「只看我参与的」 keeps started / replied / mentioned; without `updatesOthersComments`, ✓ only on the viewer's own threads; the resolver named from a mention list already loaded, never read for it; all resolved → the note and 「Show all comments」; no ✓ and no filter where rows carry no `resolved`; no ✓ without the write; a moderator's Edit / Delete on another's comment; a moderator whose update of others' rows is refused gets Delete, not Edit; `updatesOthersComments` alone is not moderating; the CONTROL without moderation; none without the host's writes; the count is unresolved threads, and every thread with no resolution stored.
- `plugin-detail/src/useRecordVerdict-36075.test.tsx` (6): true / false; `allowed: false` beside a visible record reads false, a visible record with no `allowed` reads `undefined`; `undefined`, never true, while pending, on non-OK, offline, and no record verdict; nothing asked when disabled; CONTROL `useRecordEditable` still fails open; one shared question.
- `app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.commentsResolved-36075.test.tsx` (15), the real `RecordDetailView`: the icon counts 1 of 2 threads and the resolved one appears under 「显示已解决」 named; a resolver the page cannot name read by id, once, and named; no user read when every resolver is named; ✓ writes exactly `{ is_resolved: true }` on the top-level row, the thread leaves, the count goes; a refused ✓ toasts and changes nothing; reopen writes `{ is_resolved: false }` and the count returns; a reply into a resolved thread reopens it; another member's comment offers Edit / Delete on an explain allow, not on a refusal, not on an answer with no record verdict; ✓ on another member's thread beside a moderation refusal (N3); the row floor: ONE `sys_comment` explain, only once the reader reaches into the open panel; refused → no ✓ and no Edit on others' rows, Delete still, own rows unchanged; admitted → ✓ and Edit; no answer → own threads alone.
- Reverse checks: with the moderation gate made fail-open (`!== false`), 「not offered on a guess」 fails; with the row-floor gate made fail-open, 「not on a guess: no answer offers ✓ on the viewer's own threads alone」 fails; with the old `record.visible`-only reading, the `allowed: false` case fails.
- `RecordDetailView.recordOpenOneRequest-28470` pins that opening the panel reads nothing more; the probe waits for the reader to reach into the panel for that reason.

**Local runs** (at `c268e113`, base main `6aacad95`): every `app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.*`, `recordDrawer*`, `recordCommentsPanel*` file and the whole `plugin-detail/src` (504 files, 4,517 tests): all pass but one at the first reading, `hiddenAffordanceVerdicts-13045` (the moderation verdict was asked on open where `userActions.edit: false` asks none); fixed by asking it once the panel opens, then that file and the comment files re-run green (7 files, 65 tests). `type-check` (src and tests) clean for types, react, plugin-detail and app-shell; ESLint on every changed file: 0 errors; `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-stale-fill`, `check:new-line-citations` pass; `check:i18n` / `check:i18n-coverage` answer exit 3 locally (they need a full `pnpm build`), CI reads them.

**Local runs at the new head**: `plugin-detail/src` and every `app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.*`, `recordDrawer*`, `recordCommentsPanel*` file: 504 files, 4,509 passed; the one failure (`recordOpenOneRequest-28470`, the probe on panel open) is fixed by asking on engagement, and those files plus `plugin-detail/src/comments` re-ran green (104 files, 837 tests). `type-check` clean for react, plugin-detail and app-shell; ESLint 0 errors on the changed files.

**Browser evidence** (seat-side folder `/mnt/project-files/build-seat1/36075/pr2/`):
- the first set (`README.md`, light and dark: the panel, the filter, the count, 「已由 林晓 解决」, admin's Edit / Delete on a member's comment);
- `floor/`: the row-floor readings above;
- `interim/` (`README.md`, light and dark), on the CRM example with the security service on:
  - a reading member on another member's thread: Reply and emoji only; on their own: ✓, and More → 编辑;
  - a record-editing member on another member's thread: Reply and emoji only;
  - the admin: ✓, and More → 编辑 / 删除;
  - E1: a member resolves their own thread, count 2 → 1, after reload 1, 「已由 林晓 解决」, reopen → 2;
  - S2: 「已由 Dev Admin 解决」 from one `sys_user?filter=["id","in",[…]]&select=id,name&top=1` read.
